name: quarter_extra_GM_HBM_quarter_unmodelled_cost
meaning: At native resident B, the synthetic reference step is 50% long-history KV service, 25% batch-independent common cost, 25% per-request common cost. OSCAR uses source-counted KV and other GM requests. Extra unpack/compute/launch/sync/merge costs beyond counted byte service are a separately assumed, non-overlapped 25% of native history service per request. None of these shares is inferred from current device evidence.
units: Native 19-FULL-call once-per-KV long-history read at the native resident batch equals 1 time unit. No seconds, clock frequency or absolute tokens/s conversion.
